title: QuantAgents: Towards Multi-agent Financial System via Simulated Trading

live_model.evidence: Sec 4.3: 'For LLM-based approaches like QuantAgents, we adopt "GPT-4o-2024-05-13" as the foundation model, setting the temperature to 0.7'; Table 2 row 'QuantAgents 58.68 299.55 3.11 11.38 66.94 16.86 1.43 2.97 1.49'

prompt.location: Appendix (per-agent prompt templates: analysis, judgment, decision, assessment agents)
prompt.note: Multiple agent-role prompt templates are detailed in the Appendix, but the full multi-agent orchestration (memory retrieval, inter-agent communication loop) is described in prose rather than as one reproducible prompt.

claim.location: Table 2, row QuantAgents, ARR(%) column; NASDAQ-100 constituents, test period 2021-2023

data.source: Yahoo Finance market data (public) + Alpaca News API text data (partial/commercial access); NASDAQ-100 constituents, 2010-2023

notes: QuantAgents is a multi-agent trading framework (multiple agent roles plus a memory module) with GPT-4o-2024-05-13 as the shared backbone; reproducing the headline ARR/TR numbers needs the full orchestration pipeline (memory management, 60 technical indicators, news retrieval), not just a single prompt. A dead GPT-4-1106-preview appears elsewhere as a separate comparison point.
